_about: Parts held back after human review because the SOURCE PAGE itself is wrong. Quote checks confirm a part matches its page, so they cannot catch an error printed on the page. Any passed part whose stored artifact quotes a held sentence is served as held back, with the reason shown to the teacher. Stored runs are never rewritten.

holds.quote: Chemosynthesis – hydrogen sulfide supplies the energy to convert carbon dioxide and water to glucose and hydrogen sulfide.
holds.reason: The source page lists hydrogen sulfide as a product of chemosynthesis. In chemosynthesis hydrogen sulfide is used up, not produced, so a part built on this sentence would teach an error.
